gbm_population_evidence.quote: A histological or cytological diagnosis of solid tumors and metastatic disease or locally advanced disease.
The Phase 2 part will test the combination of ONC-841 with SOC in GBM and in CRC.

candidate_evidence.quote: ONC-841 is an investigational drug being developed as an anti-tumor treatment.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Safety, Pharmacokinetics (PK), and Efficacy of ONC 841 in Advanced Solid Tumors

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: The highest Serum concentration of ONC-841 after IV infusion at cycle 1 and cycle 3

role_evidence.quote: ONC-841 will be given by IV infusion in designated dose, q4w.

agents.drug_class_hint: investigational humanized IgG4 anti-SIGLEC10 monoclonal antibody (ONC-841)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: ONC-841 binds to Siglec10 to block the "do not eat me" signals that cancer cells give to immune system, which allow macrophages and neutrophils to "eat" the tumor cells.

coder_notes: Solid-tumour basket; GBM is mentioned only in the brief summary (planned Phase 2 GBM cohort with SOC), not in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or arm labels, so per C7/D27B coded not_glioblastoma. Adjudicator may wish to confirm. basket set true as the design is a multi-cancer trial. Registered phase PHASE1 only; the Phase 2 combination with SOC is not registered as an arm, so no SOC agents listed. Development code written 'ONC 841' in title and 'ONC-841' elsewhere; moiety uses 'onc-841'. Serum-only PK.
